Read [the shared planning workflow](../instructions/planning.instructions.md), then follow its Functional specification section. Interview the developer for anything missing and update the existing `docs/functional-spec.md`, preserving unrelated requirements and following its existing template. Do not touch `docs/technical-spec.md`, `docs/tasks.md`, `docs/handoff.md`, or `docs/planning/`.
